forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {営|いとな}んでいませんでした

definitions.gloss: to run, to operate, to manage (a business)
definitions.explanation: To operate or manage a business, shop, or enterprise. Slightly more formal and literary than {経営|けいえい}する.

definitions.gloss: to conduct, to carry out (a ceremony or life activity)
definitions.explanation: To carry out or perform certain life activities, ceremonies, or rituals. Used in more literary or formal contexts.

notes:
Godan verb (む row: {営|いとな}む → {営|いとな}まない → {営|いとな}んで). Has a literary quality that makes it common in written language and formal descriptions.

Sense 1 typically takes a business or shop as its object. Sense 2 is used for ceremonies (⟦{葬儀|そうぎ}→葬儀：15337_sougi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{営|いとな}む) and for broader descriptions of how one lives one's life (⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{営|いとな}む).

The noun form ⟦{営|いとな}み→営み：11904_itonami⟧ means 'activity' or 'livelihood.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{商売|しょうばい}→商売：03239_shoubai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{営|いとな}む — to run a business
- ⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{営|いとな}む — to operate a shop
- ⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{営|いとな}む — to lead a life
- ⟦{葬儀|そうぎ}→葬儀：15337_sougi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{営|いとな}む — to hold a funeral
